1. (Currently amended) A method for generating a superframe preamble for a superframe, the superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols, in an orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) network, comprising: for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier; and for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel, __wherein the first broadcast channel and the second broadcast channel are different broadcast channels within the superframe preamble and are each mapped to respective sets of subcarriers of the carrier in the first one of the symbols__.

2. (Previously presented) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over substantially the entire carrier.

3. (Previously presented) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over substantially the entire carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern.

4. (Previously presented) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the second set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier.

19. (Currently amended) A superframe generator in a base station in an OFDM network, comprising a preamble generator operable to generate a superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols for a superframe by (i) for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier, and (ii) for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel, __wherein the first broadcast channel and the second broadcast channel are different broadcast channels within the superframe preamble and are each mapped to respective sets of subcarriers of the carrier in the first one of the symbols__.

20. (Previously presented) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over substantially the entire carrier.

21. (Previously presented) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over substantially the entire carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern.
